{{Quote|Stay away, Bane! ''Stay away''!''"<br />"''Oh, but I ''have'' stayed away! And what's more, I never had any intention of returning to this floating ''garbage barge''.|Soopan and Cad Bane|<ref name="BVB">{{TCWComicCite|6.46|Bane vs ...Bane?}}</ref>}}
'''New Tayana''' was a floating [[City/Legends|city]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. At one [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] lived in the city, but he later left to forge a career as a successful [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. In his absence, Bane's former friend [[Soopan]] capitalized upon Bane's notoriety by masquerading as Bane in order to establish himself as a criminal kingpin in the city. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Cad Bane returned to New Tayana and confronted his old friend, to warn Soopan off from using his identity.
